verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation is a plausible axis for a package manager and build system like Nix, since such tools can expose hooks. The pack, however, documents no user-definable rules or event triggers. The auto-gc mention (nix-comm-8) and NixOS systemd service configuration (nix-comm-4) are adjacent features or host-platform capabilities, not a rules-on-events capability, so they earn no credit.
